Bengaluru Boy Abducted and Killed for Ransom; Neighbour Arrested

A 13-year-old boy was abducted and subsequently killed for ransom in Bengaluru. Police have arrested a neighbour in connection with the crime. The incident involved the boy being taken and later found deceased, with ransom being a motive. Details indicate the neighbour's involvement led to the arrest.
